manifest.purpose: Executable architecture governance for AFEP batches. This manifest is subordinate to docs/truth/*, live source, and current proof evidence and may not override them.
manifest.authority_statement: This manifest is governance-only. It is subordinate to docs/truth/*, live source, and current proof evidence and may not override them.

local_first_authority.source_of_truth: local repo source plus current proof evidence
local_first_authority.cloudkit_continuity: optional continuity only, never the source of truth

core_llm.rule: External or cloud LLMs are not part of core architecture.

hosted_backend.rule: A hosted personal-data backend is not required for launch.

telemetry.rule: No analytics or telemetry SDK may be introduced without explicit approval.

release_readiness.rule: Release or readiness claims require proof and current evidence.

hard_red_drift_conditions: required cloud or core LLM dependency
analytics or telemetry SDK without explicit approval
CloudKit treated as source of truth
release or readiness claims without proof
validation_boundaries: local validation is not release proof
local validation is not device proof
local validation is not accessibility proof
local validation is not privacy proof
local validation is not CI proof
local validation is not production proof

steps: Remove the manifest, validator, fixtures, and AFEP-025 audit reports.
Keep docs/truth/*, AGENTS.md, README.md, and existing source truth as the active authority path.
Re-run claim scans and git diff --check before closing the batch.

claim_boundaries: This manifest is not release proof.
This manifest is not runtime behavior.
This manifest is not production readiness.
This manifest is not accessibility proof.
This manifest is not privacy/legal approval.
This manifest is not CI proof.
